messages.subject: changing colors in stat_bin2d
parts:
Hi Everyone:

I want to use the scale_colour_brewer with stat_bin2d. Does anyone know
how to fix this?

dat <- data.frame(cbind(x=runif(100, min=0, max=10), y=runif(100, min=0,
max=10)))
(p2 <- ggplot(dat, aes(x=x, y=y))) + stat_bin2d(bins=20) +
aes(fill=scale_colour_brewer(palette="BuPu"))

Thanks!

Jeff

messages.author: 66a7bbbceef834e9
messages.subject: Re: changing colors in stat_bin2d
parts:
Hi Jeff,
the fill argument is declared in the wrong place. I think it must be declared in the ggplot call or in the geom call. Like this:

(p2 <- ggplot(dat, aes(x=x, y=y))) + stat_bin2d(bins=20, fill=scale_colour_brewer(palette="BuPu"))

Bye

Luciano


2009/10/15 Jeff A Tracey <jatrac...@gmail.com>

> dat <- data.frame(cbind(x=runif(100, min=0, max=10), y=runif(100, min=0,

> (p2 <- ggplot(dat, aes(x=x, y=y))) + stat_bin2d(bins=20) +

Try this:

ggplot(dat, aes(x, y)) +
stat_bin2d(bins = 20) +
scale_fill_brewer(palette="BuPu")
